newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Serfin cut by Abaco.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Serfin cut by Abaco.

text.p: Abaco brokerage said Thursday it had downgraded Grupo Financiero Serfin to sell from hold.

Analyst Carole Milnes did the downgrade on Tuesday before Serfin announced the sale of 19.9 percent of its stock to HSBC Holdings. She said the sale, announced later that day, did not change her decision.

"The funds from this alliance will be used to pay off the debt outstanding from JP Morgan ($290 million), with a further $433 million capital still to be raised before June 1997 following last year's capitalization program," an Abaco statement said.

Milnes said new Mexican bank accounting standards and a pledge to repay the government part of its future earnings in part exchange for the sale of 10.3 billion pesos of mortgage loans were additional reasons for the downgrade.
